result.title: vividRGB: Various visual cue detection in RGB photographs with forced focused attention
result.comment: 32 pages including supplementary material; 6 numbered figures and a graphical summary
result.summary: Natural photographs contain dense, overlapping structures that can be weakly expressed in feature maps from whole-image vision encoders. We introduce forced focused attention (FFA) and its Python implementation, vividRGB. FFA is an encoder-agnostic inference-time procedure that applies a frozen encoder to enlarged, overlapping local crops, averages inverse-aligned reflections, and reconstructs a feature field in source coordinates. We evaluate 50 high-resolution photographs from grassland vegetation, fungal networks, airborne forests, coral reefs, and phytoplankton microscopy, using DINOv3 ViT-B/16. Across the five domains, FFA at 5% or 10% focus produces higher mean RGB-edge boundary F1 than direct DINOv3 encoding and automatic SAM3 masks. Domain means range from 0.244 to 0.596 for FFA, versus 0.028-0.076 for direct DINOv3 and 0.020-0.090 for SAM3. Qualitative feature maps also show finer appearance structure. These results concern RGB-edge preservation rather than verified species, traits, or biological segmentation. Narrower focus generally improves boundary preservation, while extraction time and GPU energy use increase sharply and gains diminish at finer settings. FFA may be useful for relatively small, high-resolution ecological image collections where dense visual cues matter. The alpha release vividRGB 0.1.0 and versioned research resources support reproducible cue inspection.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 forced focused attention（FFA）：推理期把冻结编码器依次作用于放大、重叠的局部裁剪，对反向对齐的反射结果取平均，再重建回源坐标形成特征场，以恢复高分辨率自然照片中被弱表达的密集重叠结构，并在五类生态图像上以 RGB 边缘 F1 对比直接编码与 SAM3 掩码。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「推理期局部裁剪重编码＋回投影取平均」的处理方式，可供核查作为 VLM 视觉细节保留与证据筛选的旁路线索；但论文仅评估 RGB 边缘保真度与提取成本，未涉及 latent 推理状态或答案对该内容的实际使用。
